title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-04-07
content:
Solutions + Pro Services Weekly Sync — 2026-04-07

Attendees: Samira Khan (owner), Diego Martinez, Priya Rao, Evan Brooks, Jordan Lee (SRE), Ana Valdez (SE)
Absentees: none
Duration: 45m
Location: Zoom / #pros-weekly

Agenda:
- Quick round-robin customer statuses (15m)
- Blockers & escalation candidates (10m)
- Capacity planning / Dedicated reservations (5m)
- Action items & next steps (15m)

Notes / Highlights:
1) Acme Corp (priority: high)
   - Current phase: Private deployment validation (VPC + KMS). Customer running POC integration tests against Private control plane.
   - This week: Completed basic connectivity tests, KV cache warmup observed. End-to-end generation tests show ~20% higher latency vs expected at 2k sequence lengths.
   - Root cause hypothesis: kernel selection falls back to unfused kernels for certain ops when using customer's GPU drivers (NVIDIA 535 vs recommended 540).
   - Blockers: Customer requires HSM/KMS audit logs to pass before data-plane tests. Waiting on security team to produce audit export sample.
   - Tickets: PROSERV-482 (private deployment infra mismatch), PROSERV-497 (audit log format request).
   - Action items:
     * Jordan Lee (SRE) to validate driver/kernel compatibility matrix with customer infra — due 2026-04-09.
     * Priya Rao (SE) to share sample audit log export and mapping doc with Acme security — due 2026-04-08.
     * Samira to schedule Exec touchpoint if audit logs not delivered by 2026-04-10.
   - Notes: consider offering temporary Hosted fallback route for low-latency endpoints until Private is fully green.

2) VeloHealth (priority: medium)
   - Current phase: Deployment to Dedicated capacity + model quantization validation.
   - This week: Model served on Dedicated with int8 quant; observed minor tokenization mismatch with their pre/post-processing (detected by evaluation harness).
   - Blockers: Preprocessing pipeline uses a custom token mapping; PR needed to add token normalization step in client.
   - Linked artifact: GH PR #1298 (infra patch to add normalization example in SDK examples).
   - Action items:
     * Diego Martinez to follow up with customer engineer to validate sample transforms and accept PR — due 2026-04-09.
     * Evan Brooks (Solutions) to run regression evals against canonical prompt set post-PR — due 2026-04-10.

3) FinPro Bank (priority: high, regulated)
   - Current phase: Security review + performance SLA negotiation. On-prem air-gapped deployment being evaluated.
   - This week: Legal completed initial security questionnaire, but FinPro raised requirement for FIPS-compliant crypto for keywrap.
   - Blockers: Our default KMS integrations don't expose FIPS mode; need engineering feasibility assessment.
   - Action items:
     * Ana Valdez to coordinate with Security & Infra to produce a feasibility note (FIPS options, third-party vendors) — due 2026-04-14.
     * Samira to provide timeline estimate for Private (on-prem) delivery window for their pilots — due 2026-04-13.

4) SmallPilot Inc. (priority: low)
   - Current phase: Hosted API onboarding. Login + API key generation completed.
   - This week: Customer onboarding has kicked off trial usage. Observed early rate-limit spikes due to incorrect client retry behavior.
   - Action items: Evan to send onboarding best-practices note + sample retry backoff snippet — due 2026-04-08.

Blockers & Escalations (team level):
- Private deployment driver/kernel compatibility (affecting Acme + potential others). Need SRE + Serving Runtime to validate and publish compatibility matrix asap.
- FIPS crypto support question from FinPro requires legal/security + infra decision; potential impact on resourcing for Private on-prem workstreams.
- Dedicated capacity planning: upcoming spike expected mid-May for two customers; recommend early capacity reservation conversation with Sales to avoid 3rd-party cloud GPU shortages.

Operational / Capacity notes:
- Current Dedicated pool utilization: 68% (internal dashboard). Forecasted increase to ~85% by 2026-05-15 if both VeloHealth and new unnamed enterprise pilot start full load.
- Recommendation: provision an extra small cluster (4x A100-80GB-equivalent) as buffer. Action: Samira to open internal capacity request with infra by 2026-04-09.

Action items (consolidated):
- Jordan Lee: Validate driver/kernel compatibility matrix with customer infra (Acme) — due 2026-04-09.
- Priya Rao: Share sample audit log export/mapping doc with Acme security — due 2026-04-08.
- Diego Martinez: Follow up on GH PR #1298 and confirm normalization changes with VeloHealth — due 2026-04-09.
- Evan Brooks: Run regression evals after PR merge; send results — due 2026-04-10.
- Ana Valdez: Feasibility note on FIPS KMS options for FinPro — due 2026-04-14.
- Samira Khan: Schedule Exec touchpoint for Acme if audit logs not delivered; open capacity request with infra — due 2026-04-09 and 2026-04-09 respectively.
- Evan Brooks: Send onboarding best-practice + retry snippet to SmallPilot Inc — due 2026-04-08.

Notes to self / parking lot (unresolved):
- Need a public-facing guidance doc for common tokenization pitfalls (VeloHealth case) — priority: post-sprint.
- Decide on fallback routing policy for Private->Hosted for customers with strict data residency but need temporary availability guarantees.
- Investigate whether we should add a "driver compatibility" check into the private deployment checklist/installer (help ops & customers avoid NPU fallbacks).

Next sync: 2026-04-14 (same time).

Quick wins for next week:
- Get audit log sample from Acme security (unblock acceptance).
- Merge small SDK normalization PR and validate with VeloHealth.
- Open infra capacity request for Dedicated buffer cluster.

End of notes.

Document history / versioning:
- 2026-04-07: initial draft (meeting capture).
- 2026-04-08: updated with driver compatibility owner and infra capacity note.
